Recommended Supplier: Insituform Technologies Limited Contract Award Value: $4,525,327 net of all applicable taxes and charges $5,113,620 including HST and all applicable charges $4,604,973 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on December 31, 2024.
